In brief: The upcoming week in Abuja will be characterized by a high likelihood of rainfall, with temperatures ranging from 22°C to 30°C, and humidity levels remaining relatively high throughout the period. ### Monday The current weather pattern is dominated by a low-pressure system situated over the northern parts of the country, which is expected to influence the weather in Abuja throughout the week. On Monday, the temperature is forecast to reach a high of 30°C, while the low is expected to be around 22°C. The rain chance is pegged at 76%, with the majority of the precipitation expected to fall in the late afternoon and evening hours. The Maitama and Garki areas can expect to experience the highest rainfall accumulation, with totals ranging from 10 to 20 mm.
The wind direction on Monday will be from the southwest, blowing at a moderate speed of 15 km/h. This will lead to an increase in humidity levels, especially in the Wuse and Gwarinpa areas, which are known to be more prone to high humidity due to their proximity to low-lying areas. The humidity level is expected to peak in the late morning, reaching a high of 95%. Residents in the Aso Rock area can expect to experience a slightly cooler temperature due to the elevation, with the high temperature expected to be around 28°C. However, the wind direction and speed will still lead to a relatively high humidity level, making it feel like 30°C. The NASS area, on the other hand, will experience a more moderate temperature, with the high expected to be around 29°C. The rain shower on Monday is expected to clear up by the evening, leading to a partly cloudy sky. The UV index will be low, ranging from 0 to 2, due to the cloud cover. The temperature will drop significantly at night, reaching a low of 22°C, making it a relatively cool night.
